buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Managing Director Chandigarh Child and Women Development Corporation payable at Chandigarh . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Generic Buyer Organization specific Integrity Pact shall have to be complied by all bidders. Bidders shall have to upload scanned copy of signed integrity pact as per Buyer organizations policy along with bid. Click here to view the file 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Tems and Conditions Sr Particulars No 1. Name of the Person/Organization/Firm location of the office complete address and Teleph one/Fax Nos. 2. Status of Organization (whether Private/Public sector-undertaking/Sole Proprietor/Partner ship/Cooperative Society etc.? If so, a copy of the constitution/partnership deed of the fir m duly registered with Registrar of firms. 3. The bidder should give an undertaking to establish an office in the Chandigarh Tricity wit hin 30 days of award of contract. 4. A copy of Resolution passed by the Executive body authorizing the specific Officer/partner for signing the documents for this tender. 5 The Bid guarantee (Earnest Money Deposit@2% of tender value i.e. Rs. 5, 08,000/- in any form permitted by GFR-Account Payee DD, FDR, Banker’s Cheque, Bank Guarantee/e-BG from any commercial bank, insurance Surety Bond or online payment-va lid 45 days beyond the bid validity. MSEs and DPIIT-recognized start-ups exempt. Physical delivery of originals only for verification before award. 6. An affidavit amounting to Rs. 100/- on the Non-judicial stamp paper on or after the date o f publication of bid, duly attested by the Notary regarding non-black listing/non-prosecuti on of tenderer/firm. OR A self-declaration digitally signed on GeM may also be accepted. 7. The bidder should submit a self-declaration that it is not under liquidation, court receivers hip or in solvency proceedings. 8. A self-attested copy of ITR for assessment years 2024-25, 2025-26 & 2026-27 to match t he financial years 2023-24 to 2025-26, used for turnover, experience & statutory dues. V alid Income Tax Clearance Certificate, PAN/TAN No. issued by the competent authority. 9. A self-attested copy of GST Number.

10. v A self-attested copy of PSARA license. v A self-attested copy of valid Labour License issued by the Chandigarh Administration. I n case, the bidder is not registered with Labour Department, U.T., Chandigarh, they w ill have to submit undertaking to obtain License from the Labour Department, U.T., C handigarh within 30 days from the date of commencement of work. v A self-attested copy of EPF, ESIC registration codes issued by the Regional Provident Fu nd Office, which are required under any Labour Law and other Legislation for providin g the services under the Service Agreement. 11. The bidder shall upload an undertaking (CA Certified) in the form of affidavit, confirming non-default in the deposit of statutory contributions such as EPF, ESI and GST during the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. 12. Turnover Certificate duly certified by CA for financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The Average Annual gross billing during the last three years, ending 31st March of the pr evious financial year, should be at least 1.5 times of the estimated annual cost subject to an added criterion of liquid assets or credit facility of at least 2 months estimated billing. 13. The tenderer(s) should have provided/executed services/contract relating to supply of Ge neral Manpower for the last 07 financial years; experienced with the Central/State Govern ment, PSUs, Nationalized Banks as per the following values/volume:- a. Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cost. Or b. Two similar completed services costing not less than amount equal to 50% of the estim ated cost. Or c. One similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the es timated cost. 14. The pre-integrity pact duly signed should be uploaded by the bidder alongwith the bid doc uments. 15. Acceptance of Terms & Conditions 16. The Service Provider must disburse the salary/ payment from his own resources to all em ployees by 7th of the every month through their bank account and submit proper docum entary evidence in this regard, as per GeM Policy. 17. A prequalification evaluation shall be conducted to determine the eligibility of bidders. T he documents specified under the Prequalification Requirements shall be examined at t he first instance. v Affidavit as prescribed in the tender document. v Self-declaration as prescribed in the tender document. v Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) in the prescribed form and amount or exempted cate gories defined in GFR. v Valid PSARA License v Statutory registrations (GST, PAN, etc.) v Signed and stamped tender document v Any bidder whose prequalification documents are found to be incomplete, deficient, incorrect, or not in conformity with the tender conditions shall be liable for rejectio n. However, clarification, as per the policy of Government e-Marketplace (GeM), m ay be sought from all bidders, if required, for the purpose of further evaluation.

18. The bidder claiming EMD exemption shall upload valid documentary proof establishing its eligibility for EMD exemption under the same category as claimed and reflected in the EM D Status on the GeM Portal at the Buyer end. For example, where exemption is claimed un der the Start-up category, the document(s) shall establish that the bidder/firm itself is duly recognized as a Start-up by the competent/designated authority and is eligible for EMD ex emption for the services covered under this Bid. No specific Designated Agency/Authority has been prescribed by the Buyer in this Bid. Any deviation or mismatch in the exemption category claimed, or failure to furnish valid documentary proof establishing eligibility for t he claimed EMD exemption, shall result in outright rejection of the Bid. 19. Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and showing the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s)/Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be consider ed for further evaluation. 20. Any other relevant information . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 9. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 10. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 11. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 12. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Managing Director Chandigarh Child and Women Development Corporation payable at Chandigarh . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 13. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under.
